content:
riley: Proposal: LakeView Analytics private deployment cutover on Fri 2026-05-14 04:00-04:45 UTC (quiet window). Asking for final ops + product thumbs and rollback acceptance.

mona: Product ack, remember to include the small schema tweak in the notes (non-destructive). No PHI.

theo: Ops ack in principle. Confirming we'll pin to runtime rwd-infer-3.2.0-jit and not the quantized variant for this customer due to throughput constraints.

riley: Correct, pinning to rwd-infer-3.2.0-jit. Canary plan: 5% for 10m, then 20% for 10m, then full if no anomalies.

carol: I'm scheduled to monitor metric anomalies. Proposed automatic rollback rules:
- relative increase in error rate > 1.2x baseline for 4m
- absolute p95 > 800ms for 5m
- memory OOM or model worker restarts > 2 in 10m
If triggered, rollback to rwd-infer-3.1.9-hotfix.

opsbot: [opsbot] New scheduled job created:
```
/deploy --customer lakeview-analytics --env private --version rwd-infer-3.2.0-jit \ 
  --canary 5 --canary-duration 10m --next-step 20%:10m --window 2026-05-14T04:00Z-2026-05-14T04:45Z 
```

mona: Please add a 48h heads-up to customer and an additional 10m pre-start ping. Also include the rollback contact list.

theo: Runbook summary (ops):
```
1) Pre-checks: certs valid, control plane health, no pending infra jobs
2) Trigger canary via /deploy, confirm kvcache warm and model load times under 300ms
3) Observe telemetry: errors, p95/p99, memory, qps per worker
4) If auto-trigger: /deploy-rollback --to rwd-infer-3.1.9-hotfix; notify #incidents and @oncall
5) Post-rollback: run smoke suite and keep customer updated every 30m
```

carol: I'll attach a smoke prompt set and enable synthetic checks. Abort if 2/4 smoke prompts fail.

riley: Noted. Also, small DB tweak is a backward-compatible index add; no migration lock.

mona: Compliance confirmed no extra audit scope. I'm publishing release notes blurb later today.

opsbot: [opsbot] Canary started at 2026-05-14T04:00:00Z 1% traffic routed? wait, typo: 5% routed. Monitoring enabled.

carol: First 6m look good. error rate 0.05%, p95 stable. Proceeding to 20% at T+10m if steady.

theo: Oncall here, I'll stay through the window. If anything looks off ping me direct and I'll initiate rollback.

riley: Thanks all. Leaving the rollback playbook pinned in the runbook channel and posting an update in #customer-success for LakeView.

mona: :thumbsup: ship window approved.

opsbot: [opsbot] Canary advanced to 20% at 2026-05-14T04:10:00Z.

carol: 20% stable for 9m, memory and latency nominal. Moving toward full traffic at end of window.

riley: Great work. Will send final post-deploy summary and close the thread after 1h of stable metrics.
